title: Platinum Reserve Account: Using the Liquidity Reporting Dashboard
summary: Explains how to sign in, access, and use the Liquidity Reporting Dashboard for the Platinum Reserve Account, including global filters (account/entity/classification), refresh timing (~32 minutes), and historical viewing up to 24 months. Covers creating/saving filter sets, pinning metrics, reconciling to statement snapshots by date range, and troubleshooting stale or missing data via last refresh and view scoping.
faqs: How do I access the Liquidity Reporting Dashboard for the Platinum Reserve Account?
How often does the dashboard refresh, and how can I tell when the latest refresh completed?
Can I view historical liquidity trends, and for how many months back?
How do I create and reuse saved/custom filter sets and pin key metrics to my view?
